subject: maths
question: Samreen and Garima completed a piece of work together in 8 days. If Samreen can complete the same work in 10 days working independently, in how many days will Garima complete the same work alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Samreen + Garima = 8 days,

Samreen alone = 10 days

**Concept:**

1/(Garima's time) = 1/(Samreen + Garima's time) - 1/(Samreen's time)

**Solution:**

⇒ 1/(Garima's time) = 1/8 - 1/10

⇒ (5 - 4)/40 = 1/40

⇒ Garima's time = 40 days

**Hence, Garima can complete the same work alone in 40 days.**
